EOF

commit 4784448b446732d3f7a83adf4d8e4a129d9c0480
Author: benchmark <benchmark@localhost>
Date:   Sun Mar 15 22:10:45 2026 -0600

    Fix report filename collisions and add tests
    
    Report filenames used second-level timestamps, so multiple
    reports saved within the same second for the same step would
    silently overwrite each other. Add millisecond precision and
    a random hex suffix to guarantee unique filenames.
    
    Add 28 tests covering previously untested telemetry paths:
    scrub edge cases (tmp/Windows paths, Slack tokens, empty
    input, multiple secret types), TelemetryConsent Display
    trait, reports_dir path, FailureReport serde round-trip,
    save_report_to directory creation and filename format,
    prompt_telemetry message display and consent variants, and
    the concurrent-save collision that exposed the bug.
